title: CAPExportPackage
description: Structured export of RCA recommended_actions mapped to CMMS (Maximo / SAP PM) record fields. One CRRecord is produced per recommended_action. Persisted as cap_export_package.json in the run artifact store.

target_system.description: Target CMMS. Controls which field-map defaults are applied and which system-specific extension block is populated.

cr_records.description: One record per recommended_action. Each maps to a single Corrective Action / Work Order in the target CMMS.

export_record_id.description: Unique ID for this record within the package. Format: {export_id}::{source_action_id}

source_action_id.description: rca_card.recommended_actions[i].action_id — links back to the RCA artifact.

action_type.description: Original RCA action_type value (preserved for traceability).

cr_type.description: CMMS record type code (e.g. CAL, PM, TQ for Maximo; M1, M3, Q3 for SAP PM).

short_description.description: Truncated to target CMMS short-description field limit.

long_text.description: Full narrative including RCA run reference, rationale, and expected observation.

priority.description: Original RCA priority label (critical / high / medium / low).

functional_location.description: Maximo FLOC resolved from kg_context.components[].maximo_floc. Null when unresolved.

equipment_id.description: SAP PM equipment ID resolved from kg_context.components[].sap_equipment_id. Null when unresolved.

target_component_id.description: KG component_id from the source recommended_action. Always preserved for traceability even when FLOC/equipment_id is resolved.

mapping_status.description: resolved = functional_location or equipment_id was set from KG. unresolved = KG property absent; field is null.

owner.description: Passed through from recommended_action.owner. Null if not set.

maximo_ext.description: Maximo-specific extension fields (work_group, site_id, etc.). Populated only when target_system == maximo.

sap_ext.description: SAP PM extension fields (plant_section, planner_group, etc.). Populated only when target_system == sap_pm.

unresolved_locations.description: component_ids for which no FLOC/equipment_id mapping was found in the KG. These cr_records have mapping_status=unresolved and require manual CMMS field completion.

field_map_source.description: Which field-map file was used (e.g. maximo_default, sap_pm_default, or custom).
